symptom: ako/mxcli#870: the roundtrip CI suite (make test-integration-roundtrip) reached 29m57s against a 30-minute step timeout after #863/#864; `create or modify microflow|nanoflow` was blamed for building every declared flow.
cause: planFlowModify built the declared flow up to three times (header diff, builtAsStored, member spellings), and twice for a describe executed back whenever builtAsStored said no — which it does for any Studio Pro flow whose describe is lossy (an unrepresented merge). But the profile put the build second: the round-trip harness's snapshot labelled every unit of the fixture after every document by fully bson.Unmarshal-ing it to read $Type and Name, a sixth of the suite's CPU plus the GC it caused.
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify.go` (flowDecl.buildOnce; sameBody fast path: a body that declaredMatches the described stored body skips the build), `mdl/roundtrip/pedapp_roundtrip_test.go` (typeAndName reads bson.Raw lookups); test `mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify_build_count_test.go` TestPlanFlowModify_BuildsAtMostOnce (PedApp VAL_Feedback: unchanged 0 builds, changed 1; was 2 and 2)
insight: Profile before optimising what the issue names: `-test.cpuprofile` on the test binary and `pprof -top -cum` showed the harness, not the product path, as the largest single cost. The skip is safe without reasoning about builtAsStored: if every statement matches its stored one, the statement diff finds nothing either, which is the verdict the old path reached after building. The remaining cost is describe listing and decoding every unit of a type per describe (ListSnippets, ListMicroflows) and derivedFlowLayout rebuilding the flow inside describe.
